rules.accepted_credit_types: Germane continuing education (1 contact hour = 1 clock hour).
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest to compliance at renewal and must keep proof of completion; the Board's CE guidance states OTs and OTAs are audited every year.
rules.notes: 10 hours of germane CE each year of the renewal cycle. Since October 14, 2025 DOPL is moving OT licenses from 1-year to 2-year terms expiring on the licensee's birthday (odd birth year from Oct 2025, even birth year from 2026); DOPL states the CE requirement did not change, so a 2-year license needs 10 hours for each year. A December 2025 draft rule set keeps the 10 hours per year.
